lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: I'm Sophie, the manager of shelter 2.

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: I realize I should have contacted you through the proper channels, but

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: I have an urgent situation here

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: and needed to get in contact with you straight away.
What is it?

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: It's a bit of a long story.

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: Some kind of fringe religious cult has formed amongst the

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: survivors gathered in the shelter.

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: People are already on edge.

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: The last thing they needed was religious nuts preaching day and night

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: about the end of the world and the time of judgment.

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: Things eventually boiled over and came to blows.
Can you tell me more about this so-called cult?

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: They're fairly hush-hush about the details,

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: so I'm not sure exactly what religion they're following.

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: One thing I can tell you for sure is that they're not normal.
How are things in the shelter now?

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: Things have returned back to normal for the most part.

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: The only exception is a woman who went missing amongst all the confusion.

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: The doors are secured on every level.

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: I can't see how anyone could have gotten past them.
I'll look into it.

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: I know this is a big ask.

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: From what I hear, the woman has a young daughter.

lines.speaker: shelter2admin
lines.text: I'd feel terrible if she ends up losing her mother.
